fullPassage: Steve Jobs used analogy to get people to embrace the new technology. Before computers, people worked in a physical world. We used paper and pens and physical file folders and so on. The idea of working in a virtual world was radically different. Or at least seemed radically different. What Jobs understood was that a physical office was fundamentally similar to a virtual office. To win over the masses, Jobs drew strong analogies between the traditional workplace people knew well with the new, unfamiliar virtual workplace. In the pre-computer workplace, when ideas were written on paper it was called … a document. When those documents needed to be stored they were put in … a folder. And those folders were kept on … a desk. Documents, folders, and desktops are the terms we use in our virtual work because Steve Jobs understood that using familiar terms would make the new technology easier to understand. The parallels between the physical and virtual workplace now seem obvious.

det.korean: 가상의(virtual). 물리적 직장과 가상 직장 사이의 유사점이라는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① physical
❌ ② digital
✅ ③ virtual
❌ ④ traditional
✅ virtual: 가상의 — physical과 대비되는 가상 직장 문맥 일치
❌ physical(물리적인): 앞에 이미 나옴, 반복 부적절
❌ digital(디지털의): 원문과 불일치
❌ traditional(전통적인): 문맥 불일치

questions.passage: Steve Jobs used analogy to get people to embrace the new technology. Before computers, people worked in a physical world. We used paper and pens and physical file folders and so on. The idea of working in a virtual world was radically different. Or at least seemed radically different. What Jobs understood was that a physical office was fundamentally similar to a virtual office. To win over the masses, Jobs drew strong analogies between the traditional workplace people knew well with the new, unfamiliar virtual workplace. In the pre-computer workplace, when ideas were written on paper it was called … a document. When those documents needed to be stored they were put in … a folder. And those folders were kept on … a desk. Documents, folders, and desktops are the terms we use in our virtual work because Steve Jobs understood that using __________ terms would make the new technology easier to understand. The parallels between the physical and virtual workplace now seem obvious.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 친숙한(familiar). 친숙한 용어를 사용하면 새 기술을 더 쉽게 이해할 수 있다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① technical
❌ ② complex
❌ ③ unfamiliar
✅ ④ familiar
✅ familiar: 친숙한 — 친숙한 용어로 이해를 도운다는 문맥 일치
❌ technical(기술적인): 문맥 불일치
❌ complex(복잡한): 문맥 불일치
❌ unfamiliar(낯선): 반의어, 문맥 불일치
